headline: Binance Hit by $6.3 Billion Crypto Heist Linked to North Korea
summary: The world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange, Binance, has suffered a $6.3 billion crypto heist. Experts attribute the massive theft to a North Korean group.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume, making security breaches a major risk event for the entire digital asset ecosystem and market liquidity.
why_moved: A security breach of this unprecedented magnitude at the world's largest exchange directly triggers systemic fear and liquidity concerns across the digital asset sector.
